text:
Alicia Park: handing off evening shift — quick summary: saw a ~2hr window of elevated 5xxs from the embeddings pool starting ~2026-03-14T19:10Z. Root cause appears to be a canary autoscaler config change earlier today that reduced min_replicas from 6 -> 2 which caused repeated scale-down/scale-up (thrash) under bursty load. Mitigations applied: bumped min_replicas back to 6, enabled customer-level circuit breaker for heavy partners, routed non-critical traffic to cpu-embed-compact fallback model. No active P0 pages. A few partners reported degraded latency (~500ms+). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260314-87 opened — 4 pages sent (pager -> oncall) between 19:11–19:45Z. Severity: Sev2. Current status: mitigated (auto-scaling stabilized). Links: https://internal.incidents/INC-20260314-87

Ben Cho: taking secondary for the night. Confirmed min_replicas=6 is applied on all embed pools (usw1, euw1). Observed stable scale events 19:25–19:40 (no flapping in last 20m). I'll keep a watch on p95 and token-queue length.

Diane Nguyen: added one spare node to embed pool reservation (node-embed-aux-12). Logs show scale-downs triggered by the new cooldown config at ~12:12 local — that cooldown patch is the risky change. Suggest we revert the cooldown change in canary and schedule a rollback PR. Command to revert locally:
```
kubectl apply -f infra/autoscaler/min_replicas_6.yaml
```
I'll own the revert PR if Ben/Al can confirm.

Alicia Park: agreed — revert in canary and hold config change until postmortem. Next steps: 1) keep min_replicas=6 overnight; 2) Diane to open PR to revert canary; 3) Diane to be postmortem owner; 4) Next shift primary: Ben Cho, secondary: Jason Liu. Dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/embeddings/overview

deploy-bot: rollback deployed to canary at 19:55Z by diane.ng — change set: rollback-autoscaler-cooldown-2026-03-14

Eric Morales: logged outreach — Customer: AtlasAI reported ~10% errors during spike; AE looped in. No SLA breach detected yet but high error signal. Noting for postmortem and customer comms.

runbook-bot: Embeddings autoscaler playbook — anchors: mitigation, rollback, communication. https://redwood.internal/playbooks/embeddings#mitigation

Ben Cho: lowering alert thresholds for overnight (p95 > 300ms -> page) and adding a soft alarm for token-queue depth > 1200. I'll monitor for 12h and will escalate if queues start to climb.

Alicia Park: thanks all — if anything pages, ping @here and shout in this thread. Signing off at 20:06Z — Ben takes over as primary. Good handoff.
